name: Blooming Love
source:
In Blooming Love you play as a Evelyn, a 25 year old woman, who ran away from home 5 years ago due to difficulties with your father. Now your younger sister Sophie informs you that she has run away too and she asks if she can stay with you. You allow her to start living with you, fully aware that you might not actually have enough money to support both of you for long. Feeling guilty over having abandoned your sister along with the rest of your family when you ran way, you try your best to re-establish the close bond you two once had. And while doing so you can't help but notice what a cute and pretty woman your sister has become while you two were seperated.

[Edited from [url=https://brightsunstudios.wixsite.com/brightsunstudios/blooming-love]Official site[/url]]
translation:
在《盛开的爱情》中，你扮演伊芙琳，一名25岁的女性，5年前因与父亲的矛盾而离家出走。现在你的妹妹索菲告诉你她也逃跑了，她问她是否可以和你呆在一起。你允许她开始和你住在一起，充分意识到你实际上可能没有足够的钱来长期维持你们俩的生活。当你逃跑时抛弃了你的妹妹和其他家人，你感到内疚，你尽最大努力重建你们两个曾经拥有的亲密关系。当你这样做时，你会情不自禁地注意到，当你们两个分开时，你的妹妹变得多么可爱漂亮。
